in_marathi.name: Hima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hima is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘himā’ meaning frost or snow. In Hindu mythology, Hima is the name of a celestial nymph, the goddess of snow. She is the wife of the sage Kashyapa, and the mother of many legendary kings and heroes.
